claims.claim: Mark Carney is facing both a provincial secession referendum and a separatist government in Quebec.
claims.episode_span: facing both a provincial referendum to secede
claims.source_title: Mark Carney faces the return of national unity politics
claims.supporting_quote: Before this summer, it had been 30 years since a prime minister had to worry about a provincial referendum to secede. Before this week, it had been more than a decade since a prime minister was faced with a separatist government in Quebec. Mark Carney is now facing both.

claims.supporting_quote: The former Quebec premier who oversaw the passage of Canada's first-ever medically assisted dying law says he now feels conflicted after seeing how far the practice has progressed since then.

claims.claim: Alberta’s Bill 25 took effect this fall and requires teachers to present all issues in an impartial and neutral manner without defining those terms.

claims.supporting_quote: This fall, Bill 25 – An Act to Remove Politics and Ideology from Classrooms and Amend the Education Act – took effect. Among its demands is a requirement that teachers present all issues in an “impartial” and “neutral” manner.
